subject: Re: ZenLytics POC — success criteria & next steps
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@zenlytics.com>, Priya Singh <priya.singh@zenlytics.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 1 Mar 2026 15:20:00 -0700
Subject: ZenLytics POC — post-call recap & proposed success criteria

Hi Liam / Priya —

Thanks again for a productive discovery call today. Quick recap and proposed plan so we have alignment heading into the POC: 

High-level objective:
- Validate that Redwood inference reduces inference cost by >= 30% vs. current GPU setup while meeting median 95th-percentile latency <= 220ms for batch sizes typical of your production traffic.

Proposed success criteria (attached as a simple spreadsheet):
- Latency: median p95 <= 220ms for 1k-token average sessions
- Cost: token-level costs reduced >= 30% on your baseline (GPU+serving infra)
- Accuracy: top-1 generation quality parity (manual eval on 200 prompts) — no more than 5% regression on SxS scoring
- Stability: zero harmful/excessive timeout events over a 48-hour sustained test

POC scope and timeline (2 weeks):
- Week 0 (pre-kickoff): dataset access, account provisioning, and SSO/egress rules confirmed (owner: Priya)
- Week 1: integration + baseline runs (owner: Marcus, SE)
- Week 2: tuning, quantization suggestions, and final eval (owner: Marcus + Marissa)

Immediate next steps:
1) Please review the attached success criteria worksheet and add any missing metrics by EOD Tue 3/3. (attachment: zenlytics-poc-success-criteria.xlsx)
2) Confirm an internal owner for dataset access & a Slack/Teams contact for infra questions (we need SSH access window for baseline).
3) Proposed kickoff: Mon 3/8 @ 10am PT — let me know if that works.

I'll loop Marcus (SE) in for the integration plan once we have access details.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Exec, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0123
Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: ZenLytics POC — post-call recap & proposed success criteria

Thanks Marissa — good summary. A few quick notes and clarifications: 

- Latency: the p95 220ms target looks reasonable, but can we also track 99th percentile as a stretch metric? Our ops team is sensitive to tail latency spikes.
- Cost: the 30% baseline is acceptable; will confirm current cost baseline and share the billing report by Tue EOD.
- Accuracy: instead of 200 prompts can we do 300 prompts focused on our 3 primary workflows (query assist, summary, and reranking)?

Pre-kickoff owners:
- Dataset & infra access: Priya (I'll loop her)
- Legal & procurement: I'll introduce our procurement contact if we need an NDA/PO signed before the trial

Kickoff: 3/8 10am PT works for me.

On the dataset access — we can open a temporary S3 bucket and a read-only IAM role for Marcus. Priya, can you confirm by EOD?

Thanks,
Liam
Head of Product
ZenLytics

Perfect — thanks for the quick confirmation, Liam. Quick follow-up items from our side before kickoff: 

1) Expanded eval set: happy to increase to 300 prompts and to segment by workflow. I'll update the success criteria spreadsheet and re-share by EOD.
2) Tail metric: we'll collect p99 as a stretch metric and include it on the dashboard.
3) Access: Priya — to make Marcus' life easier, please provision a read-only IAM role and add marcus.lin@redwood.com with temporary credentials for the baseline runs. If you prefer, we can use a signed presigned URL for a specific object set.
4) Legal/PO: Liam — if procurement needs a short SOW, attaching a draft for review (rdw-poc-sow-draft.pdf). This covers the trial scope, data handling, and a non-production license for the duration of the POC.

Proposed kickoff agenda (30-45 min):
- Introductions & goals (5 min)
- Access verification + baseline run plan (10 min)
- SE runbook & observability (10 min)
- Q&A & next steps (5-10 min)

Action owners: 
- Dataset + IAM: Priya (confirm by Tue 3/3)
- Baseline runs + integration: Marcus (SE)
- Success criteria & eval plan update: Marissa
- SOW review: Liam / Procurement

I'll wait for the dataset confirmation and will schedule the kickoff for 3/8 10am PT once Priya confirms.

Thanks — talk soon,
